ben._.rocco: Bastian "Saint" Rocco arrived at S-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Bastian "Saint" Rocco hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
rylan_45h: In Wyvern Cross, Ivo "Bones" Rylan was a bookbinder. In R-F8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a bookbinder again.
Orders assigned Ivo "Bones" Rylan to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Ivo "Bones" Rylan added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
v01py: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bastian "Lucky" Vpy answered the first call, number 18 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Someone asked Bastian "Lucky" Vpy to wake them in ten minutes. He spent all ten worrying about how to measure them.
Bastian "Lucky" Vpy held the mirror while Felix Topekeno shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
